Where We Take You

Our Destinations

From the islands of the Nosy Be archipelago to the Avenue of the Baobabs, the wild far north and the remote anchorages of the Luna Moon voyage — every destination curated over 16 years on the ground.

North Madagascar

7 destinations
Island Base
North

Nosy Be

The Perfume Island

Madagascar’s most celebrated island destination — known as the Perfume Island for its fragrant ylang-ylang plantations. Nosy Be is our home base.

  • Whale shark encounters (Oct–Dec)
  • World-class diving & snorkelling
  • Mont Passot crater lakes
  • Vibrant local markets
See More →
Wildlife
North

Nosy Komba

The Lemur Island

A short boat ride from Nosy Be, Nosy Komba is the sacred lemur island with semi-wild black lemurs roaming freely through protected forest.

  • Semi-wild black lemur encounters
  • Guided forest walks
  • Traditional village visits
  • Handicraft market
See More →
Marine
North

Nosy Sakatia

The Turtle Sanctuary

A tranquil island known for its resident green sea turtles, wild orchids and vibrant coral reefs. One of the best places in Madagascar for marine wildlife.

  • Resident green sea turtles year-round
  • Excellent snorkelling
  • Wild orchid plantations
  • Kayaking in sheltered bays
See More →
Exclusive
North

Ankazoberavina

Hidden Gem Private Island

A secluded private island offering an intimate eco-luxury experience in pristine tropical forest, surrounded by vibrant coral reefs and rare wildlife.

  • Rare Madagascar fish eagle
  • Pristine coral reefs
  • Eco-luxury accommodation
  • Sailing & catamaran access
See More →
Iconic
North

Nosy Iranja

The Iconic Sandbar

Two islands connected by a stunning 2km white sand causeway at low tide. One of Madagascar’s most photographed and magical destinations.

  • Iconic twin-island sandbar at low tide
  • Sea turtle nesting site (Sep–Dec)
  • Crystal-clear snorkelling lagoon
  • Overnight stays available
See More →
Remote
North

Nosy Ankao

Ultra-Remote Luxury

Madagascar’s most exclusive private island — accessible only by air, with pristine reef, world-class sport fishing and extraordinary stargazing.

  • Air access only — genuinely remote
  • World-class diving & sport fishing
  • Zero light pollution stargazing
  • Private island — no day visitors
See More →
Adventure
North

Diego Suarez

The Wild Far North

Madagascar’s dramatic far north gateway — where red rock formations, emerald bays and vibrant Malagasy culture converge.

  • Tsingy Rouge Park
  • Emerald Sea lagoon
  • Ankarana Special Reserve
  • Les Trois Baies
See More →

West Madagascar

2 destinations
Iconic
West

Morondava

Home of the Baobabs

Home to Madagascar’s most iconic landscape — the Avenue of the Baobabs. Towering ancient trees line a dusty red road in one of the world’s most photographed scenes.

  • Avenue of the Baobabs (sunrise & sunset)
  • Kirindy Forest Reserve — fossas & lemurs
  • Baobab in Love — entwined twin baobabs
  • Tsingy de Bemaraha (UNESCO)
See More →

Luna Moon Voyage

5 destinations
Sailing
Luna Moon Voyage

Russian Bay

A Bay of Legends

An atmospheric inlet steeped in maritime legend dating to 1905, when a Russian warship is said to have anchored here during the Russo-Japanese War.

  • Historic maritime legend from 1905
  • Sheltered natural anchorage
  • Remote & atmospheric
  • Luna Moon voyage only
See More →
Sailing
Luna Moon Voyage

Radama Islands

Named for King Radama I

A pristine archipelago of four idyllic islands named in honour of King Radama I, celebrated for extraordinary marine biodiversity.

  • Pristine coral reefs
  • World-class sport fishing
  • Remote anchorages
  • Luna Moon voyage only
See More →
Sailing
Luna Moon Voyage

Nosy Lava

Hidden History & Wilderness

A hidden gem with fascinating colonial history. Nosy Lava served as a French maximum-security penal colony until 2002, with ruins that can still be explored today.

  • Abandoned colonial prison ruins
  • Towering limestone cliffs
  • White sand beaches
  • Luna Moon voyage only
See More →
Sailing
Luna Moon Voyage

Baie de Moramba

Madagascar’s Miniature Halong Bay

An extraordinary maze of mushroom-shaped limestone tsingy formations rising from emerald water, best explored by kayak through hidden coves.

  • Limestone tsingy from the water
  • Kayak hidden coves & channels
  • Endemic parrots & cliff birds
  • Luna Moon voyage only
See More →
Culture
Luna Moon Voyage

Mahajanga

Where Cultures Meet

A vibrant coastal town where African, Arab, Indian and French influences converge. Known for its baobab-lined promenade and Katsepy sifaka lemurs.

  • Baobab-lined seafront promenade
  • Multicultural markets & architecture
  • Katsepy sifaka lemurs
  • End point of the Luna Moon voyage
See More →

 Signature Voyage

Explore by Sea aboard
Luna Moon

The Luna Moon voyage destinations — Russian Bay, the Radama Islands, Nosy Lava and Baie de Moramba — are accessible only by sailing expedition. Our 115-year-old historic schooner is the only way to reach these extraordinary remote anchorages.
